defect: The fix only casts m_input_sample_rate to int in the new sample-rate comparison to silence a signed/unsigned comparison warning.
reason: Sample rates are small positive values, so the int vs u32 comparison already behaved correctly; this is warning cleanup, not a defect repair.

defect: The fix only casts ARRAY_SIZE(buffer) to int in the sz bound check to silence a signed/unsigned comparison warning.
reason: sz >= 16 is checked first, so the mixed-sign comparison could never misbehave; the fix changes no behaviour.

defect: The fix plugs a texture-name leak by allocating a name in BuildTexture only when the entry has none and not for framebuffer entries, and skips glDeleteTextures for name 0.
reason: The leaking AllocTextureName code in BuildTexture is years older than this change, which only made glDeleteTextures in ReleaseTexture conditional on delete_them (all callers but device-lost pass true), and the added name != 0 check is a no-op for glDeleteTextures.

defect: The fix wipes queued steps and clears frame steps in StopThread and waits for device idle when the submission thread quits, to fix device-loss bugs.
reason: This change only reworded log messages and added a warning log; the missing cleanup on thread stop was already there before it.

defect: The new cap in vf2i compares and assigns through a float, but (float)0x7fffffff rounds to 2^31, so large positive values are capped to 2^31 and the int conversion overflows to 0x80000000 instead of saturating to 0x7fffffff.
reason: The fix changes exactly the float sv added by this change to double so the cap works, and the precision loss of 0x7fffffff in a float is visible in the added lines.

defect: The fix drops the Android-only 'assets/lang' path so the language list is read from 'lang' on Android too.
reason: The ANDROID 'assets/lang' branch existed before this change, which only renamed the output vector; it became wrong when a later VFS fix made the workaround obsolete (as with ca8311b for shaders).

defect: The fix only casts textureData.size() to int when calling CreateTextureFromFileData to silence a size_t-to-int conversion warning.
reason: PNG data is far below 2 GB, so the implicit conversion was harmless; the change's real bug (tex->Release() on a null tex) is not touched by this fix.

defect: The new specular term adds att*spot*lsc*msc*pow(specular_factor, k) even when specular_factor is negative (surface facing away), producing negative or NaN specular contributions.
reason: The fix wraps exactly the specular accumulation lines added by this change in 'if (specular_factor > 0.f)', and the missing guard is visible in the added code (the diffuse guard was already commented out before).

defect: The fix changes the %ld format specifier for startingPlugins.size() in a log line to %lld to silence a compiler warning.
reason: The size_t/%ld mismatch in an INFO_LOG has no observable effect on PPSSPP's platforms (and %lld is not more correct on LP64), so this is warning cleanup rather than a defect repair.

defect: The fix changes %d to %lu for a DWORD and %08x to %08lx for an HRESULT in two log lines to silence format warnings.
reason: DWORD and HRESULT are 32-bit on Windows, the only platform of this file, so the old specifiers printed correctly; this is warning cleanup.

defect: The fix checks mmap for MAP_FAILED in AllocateMemoryPages, rounds FreeMemoryPages to the real page size, and writes the mprotect result check as != 0.
reason: The mmap NULL check and the 4095 rounding predate this change, and mprotect returns only 0 or -1, so the change's 'retval < 0' was already correct.

defect: In this file the fix only extends the comment on the author '&&' replacement line.
reason: The fix's change to Store.cpp is a comment edit; it repairs nothing in the lines this change added.

defect: The fix computes the render width/height factors from the target size in non-buffered mode too, instead of dividing by 480/272.
reason: This change only rewrote float literals (480.f to 480.0f) with identical values; the non-buffered factor computation was already that way before.

defect: The fix moves the 'Postprocessing Shader #n' title into an ItemHeader and leaves the ChoiceWithValueDisplay text empty so the choices fit.
reason: This is a UI layout adjustment accompanying a layout fix in another file, not a repair of a functional defect in the change's lines.

defect: KeyMappingNewKeyDialog::update overwrites last_kb_key with input.key_queue[0] every frame, so it is reset to 0 on frames without a key press and the dialog forgets the last pressed key.
reason: The fix changes exactly the line this change added to update last_kb_key only for a nonzero key; seeing that key_queue[0] is 0 on most frames needs the input-state semantics.

defect: The fix zero-pads small octets when CreateRandMAC formats the random MAC address.
reason: The unpadded 'std::hex << (rand() % 256)' formatting was already in Config::CreateRandMAC before this change, which only moved it into a free function.

defect: The fix splits 'std::string cpu_string = "Unknown";' into a declaration and an assignment, which is semantically identical.
reason: The rewrite in this file changes no behaviour; the commit's ABI fix is in other files.

defect: The fix enlarges Block::tag to 32 bytes and uses strncpy with termination so long tags no longer overflow it.
reason: This change only moved the Block struct, with its strcpy into a 16-byte tag, into the private section; the overflow existed before and the commit added no new tag callers.

defect: The fix maps the on-screen turbo button to PAD_BUTTON_UNTHROTTLE instead of PAD_BUTTON_LEFT_THUMB.
reason: The PAD_BUTTON_LEFT_THUMB mapping predates this change, which only rotated and repositioned the turbo button.

defect: The change moves the 'Rendering Backend' submenu translation to MENU_EMULATION but keeps SUBMENU_RENDERING_BACKEND = 7, which in the Emulation menu is the 'Enable Atrac3+' item, so that item is renamed to 'Rendering Backend' (Ctrl+1).
reason: The fix sets SUBMENU_RENDERING_BACKEND to 11 and fixes the accelerators in the lines this change rewrote; position 7 being Atrac3+ is only visible in ppsspp.rc.

defect: The fix removes the sceAudioSetFrequency declaration that this change added to the header.
reason: The declaration matches the non-static definition in sceAudio.cpp, so removing the unused declaration is cleanup, not a defect repair.

defect: In this file the fix raises several sceMp3 log calls from DEBUG_LOG back to INFO_LOG and adapts sceMp3Init to the new source-buffer strategy.
reason: This change only lowered two log levels; log verbosity is not a defect, and the buffering changes concern code this change did not touch.

defect: The new AuCtx decode/stream logic decodes from AuBuf at writePos and, on a trailing incomplete frame, returns no PCM, rewinds readPos and only reloads when AuBufAvailable reaches 0, which leaves gaps (nonsmooth sound) at every buffer boundary.
reason: The fix replaces exactly this AuBuf/writePos/rewind design from this change with a persistent source buffer and partial reloads; seeing the gaps needs the sceMp3 call pattern and FFmpeg's partial-frame behaviour.

defect: In this file the fix only renames the checkbox label from 'Sound speed hack (fill pcm buffer)' to 'Sound speed hack (DOA etc.)'.
reason: A label text change is not a defect repair.

defect: While moving the lock inside 'if (g_Config.bEnableSound)', the change reattached the 'Audio outbuffer overrun' log to the sound-disabled else branch, so it fires (unlocked) on every update with sound off and never on a real overrun.
reason: The fix moves the log back into the 'room' check's else branch, undoing exactly the misplacement this change made, and the misplaced else is visible in the diff.

defect: The fix moves the pushbuffer Flush/UnmapDevice loop in Run after RunInitSteps so that GL buffers created by a buffer expansion exist before Flush calls glBufferSubData on them.
reason: This change placed the loop before RunInitSteps, but at this commit Flush only queued a BufferSubdata init step; the crash came with 20b532f, which made Flush call glBindBuffer/glBufferSubData directly.

defect: The fix sets DoubleTextureCoordinates to false for Shin Sangoku Musou Multi Raid 2 HD.
reason: The 'true' flag for these entries was there before; this change only removed the MemoryEnd column.

defect: The fix stops caching cache.end() in the Decimate loop.
reason: TexCache is a std::map, whose end() iterator stays valid when other elements are erased, so the cached end was correct and the fix is defensive.

defect: The fix narrows the language buttons from LARGE_BUTTON_WIDTH to LARGE_BUTTON_WIDTH - 40 so they fit the grid on Android.
reason: This is a UI sizing adjustment of the new language grid, not a repair of a functional defect.

defect: The fix makes CollapsibleSection keep its open state behind a pointer (open_ = &localOpen_) so callers can keep it across view recreation, and dereferences it in UpdateVisibility.
reason: In this file the change only extracted UpdateVisibility, which behaves correctly; sections collapsing on every change comes from the local open state and the control-mapping screen recreating its views.

defect: The fix casts type to WaitType in the old-savestate comparisons to silence an enum-comparison warning.
reason: Comparing the two enums already compared their integer values, so the cast does not change behaviour.

defect: The fix shows the OK/Enter prompt when DS_VALIDBUTTON is set (yes/no dialogs too), not only for DS_OK.
reason: In this change DisplayEnter was still drawn for DS_VALIDBUTTON; the prompt went missing only when fc86a57 merged it into DisplayOk and removed the DisplayEnter call.

defect: The new SSE specializations of Vec2<float> operators run _mm_add_ps/_mm_mul_ps on the whole __m128, whose two upper lanes are never initialised for a Vec2, so garbage (possibly denormal) values cause severe slowdowns.
reason: The fix deletes exactly the Vec2<float> SIMD operators this change added; the union of {x,y} with a full __m128 is visible in the same header.

defect: In this file the fix only adds the comment '// float - no scaling' to the TEXCOORD_FMTSCALE line this change added.
reason: A comment addition repairs nothing; the UV-scale fix is in ShaderManagerVulkan.cpp.

defect: In this file the fix only adds a comment after 'expandAllUVtoFloat = false'.
reason: The fix's change to this file is a comment; the UV rescale it adds lives in ShaderManagerVulkan.cpp.

defect: The fix updates the normal and through-mode projection matrices under separate dirty flags and adds a UV rescale factor for 8/16-bit texcoords.
reason: This change only flipped the through-mode ortho, which the fix keeps; the shared-dirty-flag and missing rescale logic predate it or came from later commits.

defect: The fix shifts the FRAMESKIP_n enum values by one (FRAMESKIP_1 = 2 ...) to match the setting where 1 means auto frameskip.
reason: When this change added FRAMESKIP_1 = 1 ... FRAMESKIP_8 = 8, iFrameSkip n meant skipping n frames; the mismatch came later when 1 became auto (c9447fb and the sceDisplay change).

defect: The rewritten NotifyCommand increments primsThisFrame_ only for processed prims at the bail label, so prims skipped by restrictPrimRanges are no longer counted and prim numbering and range restriction go wrong.
reason: The fix restores counting every prim up front (compensating for the skip-once case) and removes the bail logic this change introduced, a defect visible in the diff.

defect: In this file the fix adds a DEBUG_RUN break mode for Run/Resume, a RunFast menu item and banner/disable conditions for DEBUG_RUN.
reason: This change only moved the break-next calls to gpuDebug methods without changing behaviour; the fix adds a new debugger feature.

defect: The new secondary-texture block in GetOrCreateDescriptorSet reuses the single VkDescriptorImageInfo 'tex', overwriting the main texture's image and sampler so both descriptor writes bind the shader-blend texture.
reason: The fix splits tex into tex[2] for exactly the block this change added, and the shared pointer is plainly visible in the diff.
